tools.name: get_free_tools
tools.description: Return the free browser tools catalog, destination registry, and local JavaScript API documentation. No personal data is accepted. Download the functions to process instructions locally; this call does not run models or install preferences.

tools.name: list_tunings
tools.description: Catalog of all 43 AgentTune personality tuning files (slug, code, name, one-line blurb), optionally filtered by system. Use it to resolve a user's personality type to the right slug before calling get_tuning.

tools.name: get_tuning
tools.description: Fetch one tuning file as Markdown with YAML front-matter. The front-matter links to the shared platform registry and installation protocol. structuredContent.body is the preference text; metadata stays separate. Confirmation of saved text is distinct from evaluation of behavior. MIT licensed.

tools.name: get_test_spec
tools.description: Fetch a complete questionnaire specification for mbti (32 items), enneagram (36), disc (16), attachment (36) or big-five (50). tools.name: list_resources
tools.description: Search the versioned catalog of setup guides, templates, protocols and research. Returns canonical URLs, Markdown URLs, revisions and evidence status.

tools.name: get_resource
tools.description: Retrieve one page-specific Markdown resource by the exact ID from list_resources; includes provenance and evidence status.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "list_tunings" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

title: Tool description changed since last scan
detail: Tool "get_tuning" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Fetch one tuning file as Markdown with YAML front-matter. The front-matter is machine-readable install metadata (install.surfaces = where to write it per agent surface, verify.probe = how to confirm it took effect); the body is the behavioral tuning to load as system-prompt content. MIT licensed." → after: "Fetch one tuning file as Markdown with YAML front-matter. The front-matter links to the shared platform registry and installation protocol. structuredContent.body is the preference text; metadata stays separate. Confirmation of saved text is distinct from evaluation of behavior. MIT licensed."

remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
